race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
race.verdict: BRAVE LEADER won with plenty in hand on stable debut last month and looks the type to prove prolific this winter, so he's taken to follow up. Off Spin has discovered the winning knack of late and is feared most if proving as effective on all-weather, while Tortured Soul warrants a second look with much more in his favour. BRAVE LEADER OFF SPIN (IRE) TORTURED SOUL
